elevate.move: Drive the story-pole tick highlight with ScrollTrigger so the active tick physically slides to each section's height mark as the visitor scrolls, and tie the clip-wipe direction on tool images to the ruler's vertical axis. This makes the signature the motion language rather than a static decoration, adding a fourth distinct hook type.

Replace the plain-text estimator output with a small SVG elevation drawing that updates in real time as inputs change — for the built-in planner draw the wall with bay divisions and shelf lines, for the molding picker show the profile silhouette scaled to perimeter. The output becomes a designed artifact in the story-pole's drafting language.
